reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 38 original noun questions, all complete German sentences, 152 offered options, noun grammar, naturalness and bilingual feedback. Existing production, initial, B2, workplace and general-expansion objectives checked. Deferred rare Gebrauchsweise for semantic overlap; corrected Gegenwart (present time, not present tense), Gebrauchtwagen number, statutory excerpt for Gegenstand, literary excerpts for Gefahr/Geheimnis, and distinction between Gehaltsabrechnung, Gehaltserhöhung and Gehaltsnachweis. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication approval pending.
